headline: Sewer abatement request for 92 Sidney St., a Water District easement, and an engineering overview.
summary: Staff asks the committee to confirm a $6,973.80 sewer abatement at 92 Sidney St., tied to a leaking toilet. The committee will also review a water main easement for the Bangor Water District and hear an engineering and infrastructure overview.
items: Sewer abatement approval, 92 Sidney St., presented by Amanda Smith
Water District easement, presented by Jefferson Davis
Engineering and infrastructure overview, presented by Jefferson Davis

Monday, November 16, 2026 
Immediately Following Finance Committee 
City Hall Council Chambers 
Agenda 
1. Sewer Abatement Approval, 92 Sidney St. – Amanda Smith
(Materials attached)

(Materials attached)
3. Engineering/Infrastructure Overview – Jefferson Davis
Memo 
 
To: Infrastructure Committee   
From:  Amanda Smith, Water Quality Director 
Date:  November 10, 2026 
Re: Request for Large Sewer Abatement Approval, 92 Sidney St. 
In accordance with the City of Bangor’s Sewer Use Ordinance, Chapter 252-25 (F), “Any abatement 
exceeding $3,000 must be reported to and confirmed by the appropriate Committee of the City Council 
prior to final approval and the processing of a correction or credit.” 
The 07/31/2026 sewer usage for 92 Sidney St. was 536 HCF (hundred cubic feet. The average usage for 
this property is 18 HCF. A property inspection revealed a leaking toilet valve. Appropriate supporting 
documentation demonstrates that the repair was made on 08/05/2026 and consumption reduced but 
did not return to normal levels. A second toilet was then replaced on 08/29/2026 and water 
consumption returned to normal levels on 08/30/2026. 
The excess consumption impacted two quarterly billing cycles. The total sewer abatement is $6,973.80. 
This request satisfies the requirements of the City Code, Chapter 252 Sewers and Drains §252-25 
Abatement of and discounts to sewer use charge. 
Staff recommends approval of this abatement request.

WATER MAIN EASEMENT 
Know
 All Men By These Presents, that                                                                    for one 
dollar and other valuable consideration, does hereby grant to the Bangor Water District, a 
quasi-municipal corporation duly organized under the laws of the State of Maine and having its 
principal offices in the City of Bangor, County of Penobscot, its successors, and assigns, the 
permanent right to install, operate, maintain, remove, replace, and repair a water main or mains, 
as are from time to time necessary or useful for the supply of water, all under, over and across 
portions of Grantor's land in the City of Bangor , County of  Penobscot , and State of Maine 
described in that certain deed to Grantor dated August 12, 1976 and recorded at the Penobscot 
County Registry of Deeds in  Book  2674,  Page  214,  which portions are more particularly 
described as follows: 
A twenty (20) foot wide strip of land, the centerline of said strip being defined as  
extending a distance of ten (10) feet on each side of the centerline of the water main 
to be     installed     on     said     land     running    through     and     under the  
Grantors’ land; all located generally as shown on the plan(s) attached hereto as  
Exhibit A (the "Easement Property"). 
Together with the right to construct and perpetually maintain, through, under and across 
said strip of land, conduits or pipelines, with all necessary fixtures and appurtenances, for 
conveying water, and to lay, relay, repair, maintain and remove water pipe or pipes upon or 
under said strip, with all necessary fixtures and appurtenances, together with the right at all 
times to make connections with said conduits or pipelines to land adjoining said strip by means 
of pipes or services; to trim, cut down and remove bushes, shrubbery, trees and other vegetation 
and growth to such extent as in the judgment of the Grantee is necessary for any of the above 
purposes, and to enter upon said strip at any and all times for any of the foregoing purposes. 
Reserving to the Grantor(s) its, successors and assigns, the use and enjoyment of said
strip for such purposes will not interfere with the perpetual use thereof by the Grantee, its
successors and assigns, for the purposes above mentioned, provided that no building or any kind 
of permanent structure shall be erected on said strip by the Grantor(s), and that the Grantor(s) 
shall not remove earth from said strip or place fill thereon without the written permission of the 
Grantee.  The foregoing easement is further granted subject to the replacement by the Grantee 
of the surface of the ground in substantially the same condition as existed prior to any 
excavation which may be required for the purposes hereinabove set forth. 
The easement herein granted is transferable, and may be sold, leased, assigned, 
pledged, and mortgaged by Grantee, and shall be binding upon and inure to the benefit of the 
parties hereto, their respective successors and assigns.
TO HAVE AND TO HOLD the said granted and bargained easement, privilege, and 
right-of-way and its appurtenances to the said Grantee and to its successors and assigns forever, 
to its and their own proper use.
